args.body:
• Ironbark Tooling's newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, highlighting the value of shared live sensor data between carriers.
• The linked article reports temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece notes that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
